description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Density' map layer in the Development
section.

Dwellings per km² for every mesh block in the suburb, with
the dwelling count and area it is computed from and a Low → Very high
band. The suburb-wide figure is ``/development/density``. Values only;
polygons come from ``/shapes/mesh-blocks``.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
name: suburbs_development_density_map
title: Density (by suburb)
